+# spec/requests/home_member_info_spec.rb
+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Home page member info", type: :request do
+  let(:role) { Role.create!(description: "member") }
+  let!(:member) do
+    Member.create!(
+      uid: "111222",
+      first_name: "Jane",
+      last_name: "Doe",
+      email: "jane@example.com",
+      role: role,
+      points: 12,
+      paid_dues: true,
+      car_pool_status: true,
+      joined_at: Date.new(2024, 8, 15),
+      profile_completed_at: Time.current,
+      pt_school_application_date: Date.new(2027, 1, 1)
+    )
+  end
+
+  before { sign_in member }
+
+  it "displays all of the signed-in member's information" do
+    get root_path
+
+    expect(response.body).to include(member.first_name)
+    expect(response.body).to include(member.email)
+    expect(response.body).to include(member.points.to_s)
+    expect(response.body).to include(member.role.description)
+    expect(response.body).to include(member.joined_at.strftime("%b %Y")).or include(member.joined_at.to_s)
+  end
+end

+# spec/requests/member_standing_spec.rb
+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Editing member points", type: :request do
+  let(:admin_role) { Role.create!(description: "Admin") }
+  let!(:admin) do
+    Member.create!(
+      uid: "123545",
+      first_name: "Ad",
+      last_name: "Min",
+      email: "admin@example.com",
+      role: admin_role,
+      points: 0,
+      paid_dues: true,
+      profile_completed_at: Time.current
+    )
+  end
+
+  let(:member_role) { Role.create!(description: "member") }
+  let!(:member) do
+    Member.create!(
+      uid: "987654",
+      first_name: "Jane",
+      last_name: "Doe",
+      email: "jane@example.com",
+      role: member_role,
+      points: 3,
+      paid_dues: false,
+      profile_completed_at: Time.current
+    )
+  end
+
+  context "as an admin" do
+    before { sign_in admin }
+
+    it "updates points and reflects it on the members page" do
+      patch member_path(member), params: { member: { points: 8 } }
+
+      member.reload
+      expect(member.points).to eq(8)
+
+      get members_path
+      member_row = response.body[/<tr>.*?#{Regexp.escape(member.email)}.*?<\/tr>/m]
+      expect(member_row).to include("8")
+    end
+
+    it "rejects a non-integer value for points and does not persist it" do
+      patch member_path(member), params: { member: { points: "abc" } }
+
+      member.reload
+      expect(member.points).to eq(0)
+    end
+  end
+
+  context "as a non-admin" do
+    before { sign_in member }
+
+    it "does not update another member's points" do
+      other = Member.create!(
+        uid: "555555",
+        first_name: "Sam",
+        last_name: "Lee",
+        email: "sam@example.com",
+        role: member_role,
+        points: 2,
+        paid_dues: false,
+        profile_completed_at: Time.current
+      )
+
+      patch member_path(other), params: { member: { points: 8 } }
+
+      other.reload
+      expect(other.points).to eq(2)
+    end
+  end
+end
